headline: Carlos Baleba injury 'doesn't look great' - Man United boss Michael Carrick
description: Manchester United boss Michael Carrick said Carlos Baleba's injury "doesn't look great" after the midfielder was forced off during Tuesday's 3-2 win over Roma.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal want Atlético Madrid winger

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal to sign Bournemouth's Kroupi?
description: Arsenal are one of the clubs linked with a move for AFC Bournemouth forward Junior Kroupi. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: William Saliba 'ready to go' for Arsenal after injury at World Cup
description: William Saliba has returned to full training at Arsenal, 3½ months after his last game -- in the World Cup semifinals for France.

headline: Steven Gerrard names Premier League wonderkid to watch: 'I have seen enough'
description: Tottenham academy prospect Luca Williams-Barnett has shown in just a few moments why he is definitely a young player "to look out for," according to former England captain Steven Gerrard.
